tools.name: generate_phrase
tools.description: Turns a scene into a six-character ky,zhyz phrase with gloss and updates the board. Use when the user wants a new or locked regenerate for a rant scene.

scene.description: Scene to translate; omit to reuse the current scene on the page

lock_indices.description: Optional slot indices 0–5 to keep; cannot lock all six

tools.name: get_current_result
tools.description: Reads the current phrase, gloss, locks, and meme availability. Use when summarizing the board or before sharing without changing anything.

tools.name: set_slot_locks
tools.description: Locks or clears character slots on the board before a regenerate. Use when the user wants to keep some chars and rewrite the rest.

indices.description: Slot indices 0–5 to lock; empty array clears all locks

tools.name: get_share_payload
tools.description: Builds China-social share copy and an attributed URL for the current phrase. Use when the user wants WeChat paste text, Moments caption, or Weibo title—without posting.

platform.description: Share channel that shapes the copy template
